title: refactor(objectql): generate the engine.ts section split with a deterministic codemod
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBYCcuvo7uSguGzFDstLzarK)_

Part of #29986

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增 codemod `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`，按试点 #29598 的形态（host 模式 + 杠杆 (a)(b)）把 `ObjectQL` 的 37/278 个方法体移入 13 个分节模块，146/146 个顶层声明移入叶子模块 `engine-top-level.ts`，类上只留签名、docblock 和一行 stub。生成文件未手改。按裁决 6597555122 A，按路径读 `engine.ts` 的 4 个读者跟随代码读新模块。
- 为什么改：#29465 大文件拆分的 Phase 0，继试点 #29598 与 #29985 之后做 `engine.ts`。
- 风险与回滚：纯搬移。37/37 方法体、146/146 顶层声明逐字节相同；撤销拆分逐字节还原 base 的 `engine.ts`（只剩 82 个仅被移出文本读的 import，证明从 head 重新推出这次修剪）。objectql 测试 base 10,829 = head 10,829，typecheck 两边 0 错，打包 `.d.ts` 按 6441032442 B 第二归一化 6/6 相等。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：① 下方「按路径读 `engine.ts` 的读者」表；② codemod 的 `PATH_READER_PINS`（两处 query-options 擦除点为何留在类上）；③ `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` 的 `via` 跨模块解析。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 后运行 `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --verify --base 0b99c2b1`，预期 `37/37 moved bodies identical`、`146/146 moved top-level declarations identical`、`23245 -> 16933 lines`，退出码 0；`node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --self-test` 43 例通过。
- 需要你做的：一个读数待定：13,000 行门槛这里没有达到（16,933 行），见下方「未达到的读数」，与 #29985 的分叉 6620288066 同一问题。超过 3,000 行，需您批准后在您定的窗口落地；本 PR 保持草稿。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`** (new). It plans, writes and proves the split. It is modelled on the pilot's `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` (#29598), with its rulings: 6591753301 A (lever (a): a section module may value-import from the host file; lever (b): top-level helpers move whole into a leaf), 6597555122 A (by-path readers widen in the same PR), and #24586 A 6270097840.
  - Host pattern: a moved method keeps its docblock and signature on the class. Its body moves unedited into `export function name(this: Pick<XHost, …>, …)` in a section module, and the class stub calls it with a host that forwards each member the body reads.
  - Sections are named by an anchor member (`SECTION_ANCHORS`, 17 rows). An unknown, duplicate or out-of-order anchor stops the script. Four sections get no movers and write no module: update, transactions, compatibility and migration state.
  - Lever (b): `engine-top-level.ts` takes all 146 top-level declarations (4,766 lines with their docblocks). It is a leaf: its value imports are walked on disk, type-only ones skipped, and none reaches `engine.ts` or an `engine-*` module. `engine.ts` imports back what it still reads and re-exports by name every moved declaration it exported.
  - A method stays when moving it would change what the published `.d.ts` says, what a by-path reader sees, or when the move cannot be undone byte for byte. Measured on this file (a method can carry several reasons): already-moved 86, no-yield 70, this-write 34, non-public-static 24, bare-this 17, parameter-shape 12, type-parameters 11, inferred-return-type 8, static 8, comment-in-parameters 2, path-reader 2, field-call 1, reserved-name 1, name-taken 1.
  - `PATH_READER_PINS` keeps `seedAutonumber` and `inspectDanglingReferences` on the class. Each carries one `opts as any` site that the #4918 guard grandfathers by file (eslint `QUERY_OPTIONS_UNSWEPT` plus `scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json`, a list that may only shrink). The first generation moved them, and `pnpm lint` and `check:query-options-erasure` went red on the two new files. Pinning them keeps the guard's count at 8 for `engine.ts`.
  - The imports only the moved text reads are pruned from `engine.ts` (`noUnusedLocals`), 82 bindings; a JSDoc `{@link X}` counts as a read. The proof recomputes the prune from the head's own references.
  - `--self-test`: 43 cases in 5 batteries (stay rules 12, top-level moves 11, byte-identity proof 10, import prune 4, refusals 6), each proof fed an input it must refuse.
- **The generated split.** `--write` on base `0b99c2b1`, unedited. `engine.ts` changes. New: `engine-actions.ts`, `engine-cascade-planning.ts`, `engine-defaults-and-autonumbers.ts`, `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts`, `engine-find.ts`, `engine-hooks-and-functions.ts`, `engine-insert.ts`, `engine-middleware-and-context.ts`, `engine-references-and-master-detail.ts`, `engine-registration.ts`, `engine-secrets-and-routing.ts`, `engine-security-resolvers.ts`, `engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts`, `engine-top-level.ts`. Nothing else re-exports them.
- **Readers widened** (ruling 6597555122 A). These migrate path readers; they are not edits of generated output. See the table below.
- No changeset: the pilot #29598 shipped none (`skip-changeset`), and this PR follows it.

## Tests

| Reading | Base `0b99c2b1` | Head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| objectql `test` (local) | 547 files, 10,829 passed | 547 files, 10,829 passed |
| objectql `test:repo` | 1 file, 5 passed | 1 file, 5 passed |
| objectql `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`) | `tsc` exit 0 | exit 0; test layer 39 files / 233 errors / 64 signatures held in the ledger |
| core `test:repo` | | 94 passed after the two CALLERS rows (93 + 1 red before them) |
| types `driver-error-classification.callers`, rest `error-response-structured-arm-door-parity`, cli `lowered-body-face-enumeration` | | 11, 66, 4 passed |

## Acceptance notes

### Readers of `engine.ts` by path

| Reader | Now |
|:--|:--|
| `engine-middleware-operation-vocabulary.test.ts` (#7809 weld) | reads `engine.ts` and `engine-top-level.ts`, where `OperationContext` now lives |
| `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` (#21918) | 13 rows re-keyed to the module their site moved to; a `via` helper resolves across `engine.ts` and its split modules (the stub in `engine.ts` calls the body by `.call`, so the asks are in the module) |
| `scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` | the `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` row reads `engine-top-level.ts` |
| core `second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` | two `not-a-served-read` rows: `engine-security-resolvers.ts` (`resolveFormulaRelated`) and `engine-top-level.ts` (`deleteWalkTargetOf`) |
| `docs/adr/0072` line 54 (`check:adr-symbol-anchors`) | anchor `engine.ts#expression` → `packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts#expression` (`FormulaPlanEntry.expression` moved to the leaf; fixed at `7e0e5874`) |
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts` line 35 (`check:spec-docblock-symbol-anchors`) | anchor `engine.ts#planFormulaProjection` → `engine-top-level.ts#planFormulaProjection` (`7e0e5874`) |
| `liveness/field.json` `summaryOperations` evidence (`check:liveness`) | cites `engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts` (`8f9ad27c`) |
| `liveness/datasource.json` `external.rowCap` evidence (`check:liveness`) | cites `engine-registration.ts#applyExternalDriverFloor` (`8f9ad27c`) |
| eslint `query-options/no-any-erasure` + `check:query-options-erasure` | unchanged: the two sites stay in `engine.ts` (`PATH_READER_PINS`) |
| `validate-preview-parent.test.ts`, `core-boundary.ratchet.test.ts`, `check-system-context-census`, `measure-durability-swallow-family`, `check-durability-degradation-log-level`, `check-adr-anchors`, `check-scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check-logger-receiver-detach`, types / rest / cli readers | unchanged and green (their text stayed in `engine.ts`, or they read the directory) |

Each widened reader was ablated once at head, and each one fails:

- Adding `'purge'` to `OperationContext.operation` in `engine-top-level.ts` reds both weld tests (`expected [ 'purge' ] to deeply equal []`).
- Renaming the `isFederatedUnprovisionedInjectedColumn` call in `engine-cascade-planning.ts` reds the stale-row and asks checks.
- Reverting the `via` widening alone reds `engine.ts#organizationOwnedRowCounts :: resolveTenantFieldName(): cascadeRelationBehavior asks none of isFederatedUnprovisionedInjectedColumn`.
- Adding `'ablatedCollection'` to `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS` in the leaf reds `check-stack-collection-maps`.
- Without the two CALLERS rows, the core pin reds and names both files.

### Not met: the line bar

`engine.ts` ends at 16,933 lines, against the `< 13,000` that ruling 6591753301 item 3 set. This is the same question as #29985's fork 6620288066 (15,318 lines), and it is raised with the seat, not hand-cut here. What is left:

- 86 methods are already stubs from the hand series. 70 more would not shrink if moved (no-yield).
- The big bodies stay because of the host pattern's limits: `update` (2,099 lines) and `insert` (1,384) read a private static (`homeAmountOrganizationOf`) and pass bare `this`; `delete` (690) also uses the reserved name; `find`, `findOne` and `aggregate` pass bare `this` (`ql: this`).
- Arithmetic only, not generated: moving the docblocks of the moved methods and of the hand-series stubs would save about 3,200 lines (about 13,730, still over). Adding a private-static-through-host rewrite for the methods whose only blocker is `non-public-static` would save about 1,600 more (about 12,130). Class decomposition is the other option the fork names.

### `.d.ts`: ruling 6441032442 item 1, second normalisation

objectql's dist puts the declarations in a hashed shared chunk (`util-<hash>.d.ts`), so the reading uses the dtsnorm reader over the built `dist/` of base and head, two builds each (base 1 = base 2, head 1 = head 2, byte for byte).

| File | raw | union order | statements | second normalisation | declared surface |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `core.d.ts`, `core.d.mts` | differ | differ | 16 / 16 | equal | equal |
| `index.d.ts`, `index.d.mts` | differ | differ | 168 / 168 | equal | equal |
| `util-HASH.d.ts`, `util-HASH.d.mts` | differ | differ | 190 / 190 | equal | equal |

The chunk is renamed `util-Cr4GDjp6` → `util-CBmBPpBQ`. A positive control plants a `private` → public change in `index.d.mts` and is caught (normalised and surface both differ).

| Determinism | two plans from the same input are identical; output tree sha256 `e6a99d51f5a6f3bac605faf2c61e7ad918431a8bc264086ff59fabdcc24238ff` (input `dc5677f3ef529f5272d95855361202d9948cb802a89fc3df80dca16dea3e1384`) |
| Leaf | `engine-top-level.ts` reaches neither `engine.ts` nor an `engine-*` module through any value import |
| `pnpm build` (whole workspace, docs excluded) | exit 0 |
| `pnpm lint` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `dispatch-gates --commands` at head `90b69953` | 75 derived, 75 run, every exit 0; `--ran`: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN |
| `dispatch-gates --ran` over the final change set at `8f9ad27c` | 105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (round 2 adds `docs/adr/**`, one spec comment and two liveness rows, which are reader widenings only, so `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` still hold; `docs/adr/**` is CODEOWNERS-maintainers) |
